title: Detana Twinbee Yahoo! Deluxe Pack
native_title: 出たなツインビーヤッホー！ ＤＥＬＵＸＥ ＰＡＣＫ
overview: Prepare to enter the bizarre side of Konami's creative mind with their Twinbee series! Take control of the fighter ships, Twinbee, Winbee, and Gwinbee, as you and a friend save some strange and bizarre worlds from even more bizarre enemies and freaks! This pack contains the arcade games Detana!! TwinBee (released in a home version for the PC Engine) and Twinbee Yahoo! (never released separately for home), in all their arcade glory!
